walkthroughs.body_html:
Photography and Lens-based Media — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Photography and Lens-based Media brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Photography and Lens-based Media.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What attitude does Pop Art take toward consumer culture?
options: Photographic accuracy.
It straightforwardly celebrates capitalism.
It rejects all modern imagery.
Ambiguous - it both celebrates and critiques mass media imagery.

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?
options: Just measurements.
Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Photographic accuracy.
Only the outline of an object.

mcqs.q: What were Impressionist painters primarily trying to capture?
options: The fleeting effects of light and atmosphere at a particular moment.
Photographic accuracy.
Just measurements.
Their feelings or first impressions of a scene.
